blends.name: Mythic OS
blends.desc:
# Blend up to a MYTHIC OS
Input any 4 Legendary OS into the 'Requirements' area below in order to recieve one random Mythic OS. 

**Mythic OS benefits:**
* Earn 150x parts daily.
* Beta, Whitelisted, Voting, Contest Entries, Future Drops
* Earn daily aether based on AtomicHub sales performance
* Cross chain transfers ( In the future: ability to trade/hold on eth, bsc, ada and etc )


*For help and to chat, join **Discord** or **Telegram**:*
* [discord.gg/rland](https://discord.gg/rland)
* [t.me/rlandgame](https://t.me/rlandgame)

**Visit us at:** [www.R.Land](https://r.land).
